method.association: Highest valid full-10MHz reference rate per task; fixed across scenarios; ties select RSU_0.
method.link_validity: Finite positive distance/gain/rate only; no hard distance/SNR cutoff.
method.rate_formula: Production uplink_rate_and_derivative with BANDWIDTH_DEPENDENT_NOISE_V1: B_alloc=b*B; N=N0*B_alloc*10^(NF/10); R=B_alloc*log2(1+P*h/N).
method.FULL_BANDWIDTH: Each arrived task gets b=1; optimistic isolated-link reference.
method.EQUAL_SHARE: Within slot and RSU, all associated arrivals split 10MHz equally: b=1/N_RSU_slot; same full-bandwidth association.

backhaul.sharing: Equal split among associated tasks at same RSU and slot, both scenarios.
backhaul.status: Offline project assumption; not measured deployment capacity or per-task guarantee.

method.psi_fit: sum(T_access+T_backhaul)/sum(D/R_eq), fit R first; Cloud CPU excluded.

historical.meaning: Abstract fixed per-task equivalent rate, not physical guarantee.

interpretation.recommendation: Consider EQUAL_SHARE the concurrent-load reference only if adopting the assumed shared-backhaul model; retain FULL_BANDWIDTH as optimistic bound. Select the contract before freezing in an isolated config.
limitations: All Training arrivals used, not historical Cloud-selected tasks.
Association is offline reference, not Matching assignment.
Equal radio/backhaul sharing are not KKT allocation.
200 Mbps per RSU per slot is assumed, not measured.
psi excludes Cloud CPU, which remains under the 40GHz shared pool.
Reference delays >=1 second are diagnostic, not simulated completion/queue behavior.
